notes.title: Optimized for Steam Deck
notes.notes:
Optimized for Steam Deck

Extreme Forklifting 3 is working perfectly on the Steam Deck. 
I've done a lot of testing and some tweaking to make sure EF3 is running perfectly on the Steam Deck, the game runs at a solid 60 fps at all times, and if you disable vsync and unlock the frame-rate it will even go up to about 170-ish fps.

EF3 works best with a game-pad so the controls on the Steam Deck is really great.
